environment.description: Same Terraform provider binary deployed on an identical CI/CD worker. The PostgreSQL connection is configured with role `tf_catalog_reader` which was provisioned via: GRANT SELECT ON module_catalog TO tf_catalog_reader; (no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or TRUNCATE). The role has no membership in any other roles. The pg_hba.conf entry for this role restricts connections to the specific worker IP. Additionally, the worker's systemd unit for the Terraform process specifies ReadOnlyPaths=/opt/terraform/modules and TemporaryFileSystem=/tmp:ro, and the process runs under a dedicated UID with DAC_OVERRIDE capability dropped via ambient capability bounding set (CapabilityBoundingSet=~CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE in the unit file).

config.db_role_grant: GRANT SELECT ON module_catalog TO tf_catalog_reader
